parsed.post: Discarding 1.014115. It seems my previous experiment (LR 0.08, warmup 0.05) was too aggressive and destabilized the model compared to the current global best (e124021, 1.004578). Reverting to e124021. Next: testing a conservative MATRIX_LR=0.06 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if we can find a better convergence point.
parsed.description: Testing a conservative learning rate increase to 0.06 with the successful WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to find a better convergence sweet spot.
